title.zh: 纳斯达克回应代币化争议：拒评「劝阻发行人」传闻，重申不参与OKXICE等外部场所
title.en: 纳斯达克回应代币化争议：拒评「劝阻发行人」传闻，重申不参与OKXICE等外部场所

current_state.zh: Nasdaq declined to comment on claims it warned issuers against OKX/ICE tokenized-equity trading, reiterated it will not join SEC innovation-exemption venues, and said it is advancing its own issuer-centric Nasdaq Equity Token model with Kraken targeted for Q2 2027 while denying involvement in a Wall Street Journal ad.
current_state.en: Nasdaq declined to comment on claims it warned issuers against OKX/ICE tokenized-equity trading, reiterated it will not join SEC innovation-exemption venues, and said it is advancing its own issuer-centric Nasdaq Equity Token model with Kraken targeted for Q2 2027 while denying involvement in a Wall Street Journal ad.
